component.name: ContextSnap
component.summary: Capture and restore your desktop context

description.p: ContextSnap saves the shape of your work - which windows were open, where they were, which workspace they lived on, which browser tabs were loaded and where your cursor was - and puts it back on demand.

It is local-first: everything is stored in a SQLite database in your home directory, the daemon has no network access at all, and URLs are sanitized before they are written so password-reset links and OAuth codes never land on disk.

ul.li: Restore your whole working set after a reboot or an update.
Keep one snapshot per project and switch between them in a keypress.
Park a debugging session, take a meeting, and come back to it intact.

description.p: On X11 window placement, stacking order, virtual desktops and cursor position are all restored. On Wayland the compositor does not allow unprivileged clients to place other applications' windows, so ContextSnap records what was open and relaunches it; run "contextsnap doctor" to see exactly what your session supports.
First development release: capture and restore window layouts, workspaces, cursor position and browser tabs, with a CLI, a daemon and an optional Qt quick switcher.
